phase_diagnostic.method: Main-core fenced rdtime snapshots bracket input scans incl range dispatch preparation, score kernel call, and final publish/skip. Instrumented results are separated from unmodified ELF acceptance timing. All six permutations are run once after one warmup.

decision: Keep the new paths opt-in in the small-graph probe. No measured batch reaches 1.5x. The bounds-only candidate wins the first screening but does not reproduce a consistent advantage over 5x4-bitwise. Under strict bounds, the two median ratios are 1.325x/1.266x vs the same-batch original.
